## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit has `Signed-off-by` (DCO 1.1), signed by a human.
- [ ] I agree to the DSH Contribution Terms v1 (`dsh-ct/1`).
- [ ] I disclosed AI assistance: `AI-Assisted: yes` + `AI-Tool: <name>` (or N/A).
- [ ] I disclosed conflicts: own plugin / employer / funding / market role (or none).
- [ ] No `official`, `certified`, `secure`, `recommended`, or ranking claim.
- [ ] No credentials, session data, private plugin code, or personal data.
- [ ] A `PASS` has a command output; a skip is written as `not-run`, not PASS.
- [ ] If this changes a certificate: `selfAssessed` and `claimLevel` are consistent.
- [ ] If this changes a clause: the clause ID and the comment window are recorded.

## For reviewers

- [ ] I have no undisclosed conflict with the subject.
- [ ] I did not approve my own change.
- [ ] I checked the evidence, not only the CI badge.
